effective_plan.scope: One nonescaping F64 transpose consumed directly by one ordered matrix product, derived from actual operators/liveness/geometry/ownership. Optimization15 selection/diagnosis only. No benchmark-specific compiler names/dimensions or port changes.
physical_work_removed: No transpose payload bank or initialized transpose output allocation.
No transpose load/store traversal or intermediate canonical result.
No separate transpose kernel or prepare/finish execution boundary; one admitted fused loan and product kernel.
initial_proof: One genuine selected transpose factory and one genuine selected product factory, complete same-plan operand/output schemas, sole consumer through exact copy aliases.

A bounded straight-line source continuation with only total identity copies/None between the producer and consumer; identical iteration/context, no activation boundary, outside predecessor or escaping intermediate. Other required product operands must already dominate the producer. Unsupported/intervening operators remain ordinary; extend only with an independently justified complete region.

Start with either operand transposed; exchange logical row/column strides over the retained original owner. Source matrix views remain private, nonserialized and reconstructed from exact source on independent image loading.
implementation: Reuse maintained numeric-product scalar/SIMD emission and exact synchronous NumericBinaryFrame loan. Preserve +0.0 and each dot product k order, independent SIMD outputs, scalar tails and no FMA/reassociation.

Admit both original transpose and product demands and the full old coexistence/replay envelope before mutation. Retain original selected schema/shape/current owner checks, NaN fallback, finite limits, source work/comparison charges and clone/publication/retirement obligations. Extra preflight may decline to the exact ordinary producer path.

Pin actual original operands; validate physical spans, logical geometry and all source-bound arithmetic before native access. Publish only the final product after complete success. One private source-proved bulk control transition replaces skipped callbacks; report physical visits honestly and do not pad counters.

Carry one computed output row and column from the reached nonempty product body into either scalar or SIMD cell. Derive the column from index-row*columns, sharing the quotient and removing the extra remainder division.

Compute original-row stride count/columns outside the ordered k reduction. For a transposed left operand, dynamic division decreases from one per k term to one per reached output group; empty results never divide and each cell retains its original +0/k order.

Remove the per-loan Option<(consumer,epoch)> field. Preserve the original Pending field layout; identify the genuine fused loan by a private mode in its immutable issued frame, store the entry epoch in an existing product-unused scalar word, and rederive the consumer from the same private source proof. Full issued-frame/epoch/context checks remain. Ordinary loans retain their original frame modes and layout.
IR414/work157/ABI47. The static Object evidence identifies actual repeated computations; no sampled-time attribution or runtime speedup is inferred from instruction counts.
required_qualification: Positive/negative source proof in original/decoded forms, aliases, either side, dynamic and fixed shapes; extra use/escape, branches, activation/iteration/context changes, missing dominance and wrong factories must decline.

Differential enabled/ablated/ordinary execution for rectangular/odd/empty axes, zero inner extent, exact F64 signed-zero/subnormal/Inf/NaN behavior, retained aliases, repeat calls, checked shape/failure behavior and restored helpers.

Finite source demand/spent budgets, coexistence/clone/output/node/physical denials, malformed/tampered images/loans, atomic outputs, cleanup/retry, scalar/compression maintained native regressions, all30 finite C cases, Object emission and both features.

Checked Object disassembly must show the view-stride division outside the k-loop and shared quotient/remainder coordinates; no new FMA. One new probe only for this materially changed qualified fingerprint.
